tribes.name: Tuskridge Clan
tribes.description: Exiles who refused to march in the Warchief's war. They farm tubers, herd boar and trade hides at Ashford's market twice a season. Young hotheads raid when the harvest fails.

tribes.name: Mossfang Warren
tribes.description: A goblin warren dug into the roots under Duskbriar Wood. They steal chickens and lay snares on the trails. Their leader is close to evolving into a hobgoblin.

tribes.name: Greymane Pack
tribes.description: A wandering wolfkin band that hunts the edges of the region in winter and trades furs with the Veyl. They despise poachers.

tribes.name: Seven Hooves
tribes.description: The Great Khan's own tribe, famous for its horse herds.

tribes.name: Red Sky
tribes.description: Border tribe nearest Caldrenn; most of the winter raids come from their young riders.

tribes.name: Ironhide Clan
tribes.description: The Warchief's clan. Heavily armoured, disciplined by orc standards, at war with Solmarch.

tribes.name: Bloodtusk Clan
tribes.description: Berserkers who follow the Warchief for the fighting, not the cause.

tribes.name: Sunscale Foxkin
tribes.description: Foxkin shrine-keepers of the southern isles. Rumoured to supply the Veiled Lanterns with their best infiltrators.

tribes.name: Deepdelver Clan
tribes.description: Miners and prospectors who run the caravans to Kingsreach.

bloodlines.name: Ashen Phoenix

awakening.hint: A child who survives flames that should have killed them.

awakened_traits: rise_from_ashes (once per year, survive a killing blow)
bloodlines.lore: The founders of Ashford were said to carry it. The village's name and the ruined Shrine of the Sleeping Flame both remember it.

awakening.hint: Refuse to yield a place you are defending.

bloodlines.name: Wyrmvein

awakening.hint: Touch the relic of a true dragon.

bloodlines.lore: Thin dragon blood from ancient unions. Makes the Drakari blood rite survivable.

bloodlines.name: Stormeye

awakening.hint: Stand on a height in the first storm of autumn.

bloodlines.lore: Prized by the Hollow Moon School and the Ninefold Sword Pavilion alike.

bloodlines.name: Tidecaller

awakening.hint: A child who falls into deep water and comes back changed.

bloodlines.lore: Lakeside villages tell of children who came back from the water knowing its moods.

bloodlines.name: Skywind

awakening.hint: Leap from a cliff into the wind.

bloodlines.lore: Every Ongur child is dared to jump from Hawk Cliff; a few float.

bloodlines.name: Dawnblood

awakening.hint: Give your own strength to save another.

bloodlines.lore: Solmarch claims every Dawnblood child for the Seminary.

bloodlines.name: Moonshade

awakening.hint: Pass a night in an enemy camp without being found.

bloodlines.lore: The Moonless of the Hollow Moon School is always a Moonshade.

bloodlines.name: Verdant Pulse

awakening.hint: Feed the same wild creature for seven days.

bloodlines.lore: The Verdant Oath Sanctuary seeks these children above all others.

bloodlines.name: Iron Tusk

awakening.hint: Defeat a stronger orc in front of the clan.

bloodlines.lore: Most chiefs carry it; so does Harrok Ashmaw.

bloodlines.name: Thunder Crane

awakening.hint: Meditate on the Ninefold Summit during a thunderstorm.

bloodlines.lore: The founder of the Ninefold Sword Pavilion. It has surfaced three times in twelve centuries.
